subject: gse/sgp-engine
body: CORRECTION to the SGP engine doc (code unchanged, code was always right). The doc attributed the Cholesky-safety guarantee to Higham alone. It is TWO stages: nearest_psd_higham (only when is_psd is False) AND _make_positive_definite, because Higham lands on the PSD CONE whose boundary still fails Cholesky -- a correlation from n observations has rank <= n-1, smallest eigenvalues at zero, and cholesky raises. The ridge adds exactly the eigenvalue shortfall below _PD_FLOOR=1e-10 then restores the unit diagonal so no variance moves. The test suite already carried the comment 'Higham alone is not enough here'; only the prose was wrong. Test now also asserts cop.regularized is True so the stage that actually makes the matrix factorable cannot silently stop firing. 26/26 pass, exit 0.
